listings.title: Python & web debugging session
listings.description: Stuck on a bug in Python, Flask or JavaScript? Share your screen and we will fix it together. Beginners welcome.

listings.title: Guitar lesson: first 5 chords
listings.description: Learn to play your first song in one hour. Acoustic guitar provided if you do not own one. In person in Mumbai or on video.

listings.title: Learn to make Hyderabadi dum biryani
listings.description: A hands-on cooking session covering marinade, layering and dum cooking. You eat what we cook.

listings.title: Home wiring check and switchboard fix
listings.description: I will inspect loose wiring, replace faulty switches and test your earthing. Coimbatore and nearby areas only.

listings.title: Watercolour basics for adults
listings.description: Wet-on-wet washes, simple landscapes and colour mixing. All materials supplied for the first class.

listings.title: Beginner Bengali conversation
listings.description: Learn to greet, order food and haggle politely in Bengali. Relaxed, chat-based, no grammar drills.

listings.title: Terrace garden setup consultation
listings.description: I will plan beds, pots and watering for your balcony or terrace, and send you home with free seedlings.

listings.title: Income tax filing help for freelancers
listings.description: Walk through ITR filing, deductions and advance tax in plain language. Bring your income statements.

listings.title: Gentle morning yoga for beginners
listings.description: A calm 60 minute flow covering breathing, posture and stretches for stiff backs. Online or in a park.

listings.title: English to Tamil or French interpretation
listings.description: Interpretation for a meeting, a hospital visit or a call. I can also proofread translated documents.

listings.title: Hand block printing workshop
listings.description: Carve and print your own pattern on a tote bag using traditional Sanganeri techniques.

listings.title: Carnatic vocal lesson: sarali varisai
listings.description: Start your Carnatic journey with swara basics and shruti practice. Patient with all ages.

listings.title: Maths tutoring for classes 8 to 10

listings.title: Portrait photography walk
listings.description: Two hours walking the old city to learn light, framing and candid portraits. Bring any camera or phone.

listings.title: Clothing alterations and mending

listings.title: Resume and LinkedIn review
listings.description: Honest feedback on your CV and profile from someone who has interviewed over 200 developers.

listings.title: Compost and kitchen waste starter
listings.description: Set up a smell-free compost bin at home and learn what goes in and what stays out.

listings.title: Need help setting up a simple website
listings.description: I run a small tailoring shop and want a one-page site with phone and map. Can pay back with alterations.

listings.title: Looking for a ukulele beginner teacher
listings.description: Complete beginner, learning for my own enjoyment. Evenings preferred.

listings.title: Fix a ceiling fan that wobbles

listings.title: Help drafting a polite email in French
listings.description: I need to write to a Paris supplier about a delayed shipment. Just a quick proofread.

listings.title: Photograph my small bakery menu
listings.description: Need five clean product photos for my menu board. Phone camera is fine, I just need an eye for it.

listings.title: Teach me basic Excel formulas
listings.description: I manage a tiny store and want to track stock using VLOOKUP and SUMIF. Beginner level.

listings.title: Company to walk and talk in Tamil
listings.description: Recently moved to Chennai and want to practise spoken Tamil on a weekend morning walk.

listings.title: Someone to teach me to cycle again
listings.description: Haven't ridden since childhood and I'd like a patient companion for a first ride in a quiet park.

listings.title: Need a plant doctor for my curry leaf tree

listings.title: Tutor for Class 12 accountancy

listings.title: Introduction to Linux and the command line

listings.title: Seed starting workshop

listings.title: GST basics for small shops

listings.title: Acoustic songwriting session
listings.description: Turn a rough idea into a verse and chorus with chords that fit your voice.

listings.title: Back pain relief yoga routine
